title: Google\Cloud\Dlp\V2\Key
name: Key
description: A unique identifier for a Datastore entity.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.partition_id
params.description: Entities are partitioned into subsets, currently identified by a project ID and namespace ID. Queries are scoped to a single partition.

params.name: data.path
params.description: The entity path. An entity path consists of one or more elements composed of a kind and a string or numerical identifier, which identify entities. The first element identifies a root entity, the second element identifies a child of the root entity, the third element identifies a child of the second entity, and so forth. The entities identified by all prefixes of the path are called the element's ancestors. A path can never be empty, and a path can have at most 100 elements.

methods.name: getPartitionId
methods.description: Entities are partitioned into subsets, currently identified by a project ID and namespace ID.

methods.description: Entities are partitioned into subsets, currently identified by a project ID and namespace ID.
